intent: Cryptown faction weapons based on approved Varkhen, Nereth and Draust artwork; no character image changes

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone Kalistar fantasy weapon, on genuinely transparent background. Image 1 is the exact identity reference: Varkhen's sword in his hand; image 2 is painterly style reference only. Reproduce that sword faithfully as an entire isolated object, no character: a long perfectly STRAIGHT double-edged silver-gray steel blade with a narrow violet-lit central fuller, angular swept dark iron and aged copper crossguard with a square purple gemstone in its center, dark wrapped straight grip, small angular pommel. Preserve the lean long proportions and the guard silhouette from Varkhen; do not turn it into a broad cleaver or curved blade. Composition: diagonally from grip lower-left to point upper-right, entire sword visible, generous clear margin, readable at small medallion scale. Detailed narrative painted fantasy, visible brushwork, worn worked metal and subtle violet energy, restrained highlights. No scenery, no cast shadow plane, no text, no card frame, no circular badge, no hands, no duplicate objects. Real alpha transparency outside the object.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE complete isolated fantasy rifle for Kalistar, genuinely transparent background. Image 1 is exact weapon identity from Nereth's character art, image 2 only painterly style. Closely reproduce Nereth's long Cryptown sniper rifle: very long straight narrow black barrel, straight violet energy core beneath it in ribbed dark iron/copper housing, angular skeletal openwork shoulder stock, one ornate skull relief with violet jewel eye on the receiver, large old-fashioned telescopic scope with softly glowing purple lens. Dark patinated steel, aged bronze/copper edges, restrained purple crystal energy. No modern plastic assault rifle, no sci-fi cartoon blaster. Entire rifle, buttstock to muzzle, all visible with clear margin, oriented lower-left butt to upper-right barrel on a moderate diagonal so it stays long and mechanically aligned. Keep straight barrel and aligned scope; zoom out rather than bend or shorten. Detailed hand-painted fantasy material and brushwork consistent with the references. No character, hands, background, ground, label, text, frame or badge. Alpha transparency outside weapon.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete isolated flail from Draust's Kalistar illustration, a transparent game equipment cutout. Image 1 is exact identity reference, image 2 painterly style. Reproduce one of the two identical weapons he carries, not a pair: short straight black-metal handle with copper collars and a small violet diamond set at its chain attachment; continuous heavy linked chain; large elongated cage-like flail head, pointed lower end, patinated dark steel ribs and copper edging enclosing a bright faceted violet crystal, with a small sculpted skull face and two violet eyes on its front. Match the pointed lantern-shaped head seen clearly on Draust's raised right-side weapon, NOT a generic ball-and-spikes mace. Show the full handle, the complete connected chain, and the head, no missing links. Arrange compactly with handle upper-left, chain gently curving across top, head lower-right; natural gravity, no warped rigid parts. Kalistar hand-painted fantasy textures and visible brushwork, strong legible silhouette and subtle contained purple glow. True transparent background everywhere outside and between the links, no dark rectangular backdrop or diffuse painted halo. No character, hands, scene, text, numbers, frame or badge.

Use case: illustration-story. Paint a standalone weapon illustration for a Kalistar collectible card, portrait ratio around 4:5, no frame or lettering. First image is the precise SWORD design to preserve; second is Varkhen's world/identity; third is the painterly DA. The exact long straight silver sword, angular black-and-copper guard, central square violet gemstone and thin violet fuller rests at a believable diagonal against a worn stone ledge in the gatehouse of Cryptown. Show the ENTIRE sword from pommel to tip, do not clip it, do not shorten or bend it to fit. Pull the camera back and use a diagonal within a safe central composition. A small fold of worn purple guard-cloak cloth lies beneath the grip. Fine silver edge catches cold daylight; contained violet light glows softly along the central groove. Background: a simple weathered arch and a distant gray opening, a little rain-dark paving; quiet depth, no busy castle panorama, no rows of objects. No character, hands, bodies, skeletons, extra weapons or skull piles. Detailed Kalistar narrative fantasy painting, visibly painted materials, deliberate strokes, dark iron/copper contrasted with silver blade and gray stone. Essential weapon clearly legible and dominant, not lost in fog or darkness. No photorealism, 3D gloss, poster, labels or UI.
